One app, three bias circuits: add Fixed Bias and single-supply Emitter Bias to the existing Flask calculator while the voltage-divider result stays unchanged. Every mode returns VB, VE, VC, VCE, IB, IC, IE from Python, and the acceptance cases A1–A5 are checked in a real browser."
